fields.name: flowId
fields.description: Owning flow's ItemId. Required-on-Both because the read path (`useFlowComments`) filters on it (`filter: { flowId: <id> }`) — the gateway silently drops an unselected filter field, so omitting it from a future selector would break the thread read. Matches `DirectMessage.senderId`'s 'explicit column, explicit filter' rationale.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Owning comment id for replies; omitted (or empty string) for top-level comments. Required-on-None because the gateway's strict 'Required' validator rejects empty strings on insert with 'Field "parentId" is required for insert' (verified 2026-09-27: `insertFlowComment` returns VALIDATION_ERROR when `parentId: ""` is sent), so top-level comments skip the field entirely. Replies carry the parent's cloud ItemId (UUID). Encoded as a primitive string rather than null because Blocks Data fields can't carry null cleanly.

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: IAM sub of the comment author. Required-on-Both because every PATCH must echo it (mirrors DirectMessage.senderId + Announcement.authorId). The chip / modal render uses `authorName` / `authorAvatar` for display; this column is the stable cross-rename identity.

fields.name: authorName
fields.description: Display name snapshotted at write time. Denormalised intentionally so historic comments keep the author's name even after a later rename — the alternative (joining to UserProfile on every read) would lose thread history. Optional because a future email-only-author flow could author without a name.

fields.name: authorEmail
fields.description: Author's email snapshotted at write time. Same denormalisation rationale as `authorName`. Renders in the comment header beside the display name.

fields.name: authorAvatar
fields.description: Avatar URL snapshotted at write time (provider-signed download URL). Optional so a user without a profile picture posts without one — the avatar fallback in `CommentsModal.Avatar` renders the colored initial in that case.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Comment body. Required-on-Both so an empty row (header only, no content) cannot be persisted — the modal enforces the same 500-char cap client-side. Stored verbatim; rendering applies no transforms.
